name: Tentacle of C'Thun is free at 60 Insanity (#4346)
contract: Tentacle of C'Thun 801153 costs 30% of base mana (ManaCostPercentage 30) and its tooltip reads 'While above 60 Insanity, the mana cost of this spell is removed'. The removal ships in the client data as 573315 '60 Insanity Aura', a SPELL_AURA_ADD_PERCENT_MODIFIER on MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) with base points -101, so -100% cost, masked to SpellFamilyFlags[0] bit 32 - the Tentacle's own family flag in family 31. AscensionCultist.cpp applied it with stacks > 60, one short of the aura's own threshold, so a Cultist sitting at exactly 60 Insanity still paid. The sibling threshold markers 680601/680602/680603/680604 use stacks >= 20/40/60/80, and the report from the original server is that the cost was already gone at 60.

steps.label: The 60 Insanity cost removal is applied
No mana left the pool for the cast (regeneration may still add)
